gloss: to turn upward; to look up; to improve

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {上向|うわむ}きませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {上向|うわむ}いていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {上向|うわむ}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to face upward; to look up; to turn upward
definitions.explanation: To direct one's face, eyes, or body upward.

definitions.gloss: to improve; to get better; to pick up
definitions.explanation: For a situation, economy, or condition to start improving or trending positively.

examples.english: I looked at the sky and turned my face upward.

examples.notes: Title of the famous song by 坂本九, known in English as "Sukiyaki."

examples.japanese: ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|うわ}→上〜：00416_uwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{止血|しけつ}→止血：19782_shiketsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I tilted my nose upward to stop the bleeding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上向|うわむ}いてきた。
examples.english: The economy is starting to improve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上向|うわむ}く⟦{兆|きざ}し→兆し：06633_kizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧きた。
examples.english: Signs that business performance is improving have started to appear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{上向|うわむ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My physical condition is gradually improving.

notes:
USAGE:
The literal meaning (facing upward) and figurative meaning (improving) are both common. The figurative usage is especially frequent in business and economic news. Note that this is an intransitive verb — it describes a situation improving on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上向|うわむ}く (the economy improves)
- ⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上向|うわむ}く (performance improves)
- ⟦{上向|うわむ}き→上向き：27459_uwamuki⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (upward trend)
- ⟦{上|うわ}→上〜：00416_uwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}いて→向く：02304_muku⟧ (facing upward)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下向|したむ}く→下向く：19593_shitamuku⟧: to face downward; to decline — the opposite in both literal and figurative senses
- ⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧: to improve — more deliberate, implies active effort
- ⟦{回復|かいふく}する→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧: to recover — returning to a previous good state
